newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu ends steady vs dlr on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends steady vs dlr on quiet market.

text.p: 1410 GMT - The Romania's leu currency closed Tuesday marking time at 3,295/3,305 to the dollar after it inched down in early trading on an interbank market challenged by hard currency shortages.
* Most operators said dollar sellers had been reluctant to join trading despite the leu's gentle slide in the morning.
* They said some deals emerged in other currencies, which at cross deliver better leu-dollar prices, near the 3,570 level offered by retail currency shops.
* Latest central bank data showed a $1.8 million interbank volume on Monday, when total trading was $12.6 million.
* Short-term money market rates were idle at 45-46 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
